verdict.rationale: Cognee's docs say you can supply an optional RDF/OWL ontology file as a reference vocabulary, so extracted entity types (classes) and mentions (individuals) are linked to canonical domain concepts. That satisfies the ontology branch of the story. A community comment also notes that ontology is part of Cognee's knowledge-graph setup. Missing for 10: evidence of defining custom entity or edge types beyond the ontology file, detail on how the ontology constrains extraction rather than only grounding it, and independent hands-on corroboration.
